title: Two loan-ops users report Outlook problems after EX-LAB-0002 was restored
narrative: Two reports arrive at 14:00 UTC. EX-LAB-0002 was restored at 12:30 UTC, so this is not an active Microsoft incident and is below the escalation threshold: troubleshoot locally. One reporter's laptop has not checked in to Intune for 39 days, past the 30-day compliance validity period, so CA004 will block it regardless of the earlier incident.
